post.description: Create an account and log in.
Log in. A wrong password and an unknown email get the same answer.
End this session. Safe to call when already logged out.

get.description: Who is logged in.

patch.description: Change the name WearWise greets you with.

post.description: Delete the account and everything in it, then log out.

get.description: Every list in one response: they're small, change only on deploy, and load once per visit.

patch.description: Change some answers. Send only the fields that changed; null clears one.

post.description: Mark onboarding done, whether every step was answered or skipped.
Stop offering to finish setting up.

get.description: Places matching a name, most likely first. Location data is based on GeoNames.

The weather for the days from `start` (today by default): the forecast for the
profile's city, else the manual setting, else nothing but the season.
Every note, A to Z. The list is capped, so it comes in one response.
Every category this person can use: the seeded ones, then their own.

post.description: Add a category of the person's own, for something the list doesn't have.

delete.description: Delete one of the person's own categories, once no item uses it.

post.description: Upload a photo before saving the item, so the colour can be suggested from it.

get.description: The photo, if it's this person's. Anyone else gets the same 404 as for no photo.

The wardrobe, filtered and sorted. Within one filter any value matches; across filters,
all must. An item with no seasons matches every season.

post.description: Add an item. Only the category and colour are needed.

delete.description: Delete the item and its photo for good.

post.description: Hide the item from the wardrobe and suggestions, keeping it and its history.
Make two items a matching set, such as a suit's jacket and trousers.

delete.description: Take the item out of its matching set.

post.description:
Ranked, varied outfits from the person's available items, each with its reasons.
With anchor_item_ids, every outfit includes those pieces.

get.description: Saved outfits, newest first. `item_id` finds the outfits an item is part of.

post.description: Save an outfit. It must fill a template: a top, a bottom, and footwear, for example.
Which template these items fill, and what's still needed. Changes nothing.

delete.description: Delete the outfit. What was worn stays in the wear log.

post.description: A copy to vary, saved straight away.

Like, dislike, or skip a suggestion. A new rating replaces the last one. Likes and
dislikes change how future suggestions rank.

delete.description: Take back a like, dislike, or skip.

post.description: Save the suggestion as an outfit. Saving it again answers 200 with the same outfit.
Log the suggestion as worn on a day. Logging it again answers 200 with the same entry.

get.description: What was worn, newest day first. Filter to one item, one outfit, or one day.

post.description:
Mark an outfit or some items as worn. The same outfit on the same day is logged once:
a repeat answers 200 with the existing log.

get.description: Seven days from start (today by default): occasion, weather, and the planned outfit.

post.description: Plan the seven days from start. Locked days and days already worn stay as they are.

patch.description: Lock or unlock the day, choose its occasion, or swap in one of its options.

get.description: Other outfits for the day that keep the rest of the week within the rules.

post.description: Log the day's outfit in the wear log. Logging it again changes nothing.

get.description: Events from start (today by default) for the given number of days.
What's in the laundry, and what's been worn as often as it goes between washes.

post.description: These are clean: back to available, with their wear counts starting again.

get.description: Trips, latest first.

post.description: Plan a trip: a compact packing list and an outfit for each day.

delete.description: Delete the trip. Anything still marked packed for it is unpacked.

post.description: Plan the packing again from the wardrobe as it is now.
Mark items as packed (they leave everyday suggestions) or unpacked.

get.description: Every number here is counted from the person's own rows; nothing is estimated.
The shopping list, newest first, each with its verdict when one is up to date.

post.description: Add something you're thinking of buying. A category and a colour are all it needs.
Put a staple from your gaps or starter plan on the shopping list.

get.description: Two to four candidates side by side, each with its analysis.

What it would add: the outfits it makes, where you're short, what it duplicates, and
the verdict with its reasons. Worked out again whenever the wardrobe or the settings
behind it change.

post.description: Bought it: it becomes a wardrobe item, with its photo, and suggestions use it.

get.description:
What would add the most to your wardrobe, most first: a staple, or several that
together make a first good outfit for an occasion you have nothing for.

post.description:
A staged shopping plan, best first, within the budget: each step the staple that adds
the most given the ones before it (or a whole first outfit when no single piece does).

Which things on your list to buy for the most new outfits within a budget. They're
weighed together, since a shirt and trousers make outfits neither makes alone.

get.description:
Fabrics, colour basics, and each style with the staples it's built on and which of
them you already have.

post.description:
Read a product page someone pasted: its public preview data, if the site's robots.txt
allows it, at most once a day. Anything unread is left for the person to fill in.

get.description:
Where to find a staple or a candidate: each shop's search for it, with the person's
usual spend as a guide, and demo catalogue products ranked by what they'd add.

post.description: Put a catalogue product on the shopping list.

Basics.title: Basics
Basics.description: Counted basics to pack alongside, one a day: a plain checklist.

file.title: File
file.description: A JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo

BrandNoteUpdate.title: BrandNoteUpdate
BrandNoteUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Null clears a note; the brand can't be cleared.

CandidateUpdate.title: CandidateUpdate
CandidateUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent are changed; null clears an optional one, and photo_id null
removes the photo.

DayChange.title: DayChange
DayChange.description:
Only the fields sent change. occasion_id null goes back to the usual occasion;
item_ids swaps in another outfit (from the day's options) and locks the day.

ItemCreate.title: ItemCreate
ItemCreate.description: A category and a colour are all an item needs; everything else has a default.

ItemUpdate.title: ItemUpdate
ItemUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent are changed. Null clears an optional field, and photo_id null
removes the photo.

LinkPreviewOut.title: LinkPreviewOut
LinkPreviewOut.description:
What a pasted page said, for the person to check before saving. Nothing is guessed:
what the page doesn't say is null.

Measurements.title: Measurements
Measurements.description: Body measurements in cm. The app converts to inches for display only.

OutfitUpdate.title: OutfitUpdate
OutfitUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change. Sending item_ids replaces the pieces: that is how one piece
is swapped for another.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Null clears a field.

ProjectedOut.title: ProjectedOut
ProjectedOut.description:
An estimate, always shown as one: the price over the wears a year the person's other
pieces of the same category get.

WearLogCreate.title: WearLogCreate
WearLogCreate.description: An outfit, or loose items, worn on a day. Logging an outfit copies its pieces.

WearLogUpdate.title: WearLogUpdate
WearLogUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change. item_ids replaces what was worn.
